en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an ornate neoclassical theater building on a corner square. The façade has arched doorways, tall arched windows, sculptural reliefs in the pediment, and decorative elements above the windows. There are street lamps, a small landscaped area with a statue or sculpture, and adjacent buildings and trees. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, with red printed captions indicating the subject and location, and small vertical publisher text along the left edge.
